    ## 7. Product and UX foundation

    AssetRounds remains one local-first field-work, evidence, and reporting product. V21 preserves inspection, survey, preventive maintenance, repair, and operational recheck, then adds installation and punch review as separately named activity/package semantics—not aliases for inspection and not a fabrication ERP. It inherits all V20 customer advancements—lighting, plans/references, guided surveys, scan/recurring rounds, assisted capture, durable drafts/media, and pose—through the same package kernel.

    The premium common path remains short: choose or scan the Site/asset, perform the bounded activity, capture only relevant evidence, record an honest disposition, finish durably, and produce the right audience-safe output. Labels, contact actions, costs, exchange, schedules, and recipient review live behind contextual actions or progressive disclosure; none becomes a root tab, mandatory setup step, or visual dashboard competing with Today, Work, Assets, and Reports.

    Premium means **clarity, immediacy, continuity, recovery, and restraint**. It is an internal acceptance standard, not a paid tier or public quality claim. Standard system structure and controls adopt the exact stable SDK/runtime appearance; AssetRounds keeps its accepted S10.6 color, typography, spacing, icon, component, accessibility, and report identity. Liquid Glass, when the system supplies it to native navigation or functional controls, remains a functional layer. It is never recreated on content cards, evidence, forms, reports, or decorative backgrounds, and iOS 18 receives the same semantic anatomy through its native appearance. There is no second theme, icon refresh, premium mode, custom tab/search/bar, or global animation engine.

    Apple's current eight design principles, observed 2026-08-22, become AssetRounds-specific interpretation rather than eight new systems: **Purpose** keeps field truth above decoration; **Agency** preserves explicit Back/Cancel/reversal/durable recovery; **Responsibility** keeps data local, permissions contextual, and claims bounded; **Familiarity** uses native components and standard placement; **Flexibility** preserves multiple input methods, Dynamic Type, assistive technology, orientation, and appearance adaptation; **Simplicity** keeps four roots, one obvious next action, and progressive disclosure; **Craft** requires precise copy, immediate response, complete states, and measured field behavior; **Delight** is the calm confidence produced by the other seven, never ornamental motion, glass, or extra screens.

    The visual ownership boundary is exact. AssetRounds owns content hierarchy, content backgrounds, S10 semantic brand tokens, app-authored illustrations/mark, terminology, data/state truth, semantic identifiers, report bytes, and app-authored control semantics. iOS owns native bar/control material, keyboard and permission presentation, share/file-picker chrome, standard dialog geometry, Dynamic Type font metrics, semantic system colors, SF Symbol drawing, status-bar presentation, and native transitions. Capture whole-screen context for review, but pixel-gate only app-owned regions; system-owned regions gate on role, label/value/trait, selected/enabled state, target geometry, safe-area nonocclusion, route, outcome, and focus order. A difference may be `EXPECTED_SYSTEM_VARIATION` only with OS/build/device/settings recorded and semantic parity proven.

    Use `TabView`, `NavigationStack` with value routes/paths, `List`/`Form`, role-bearing `Button`, `Toggle`, `Picker`, `TextField`, `Menu`, semantic `toolbar` placements, `.searchable`, `.sheet`, `.alert`/`.confirmationDialog`, `ShareLink`, `fileImporter`/`fileExporter`, and system permission APIs wherever an inherited behavior actually maps. This list is a preference/justification rule, not authorization to add absent behavior. Every app-authored substitute for a familiar system component must identify the missing native semantic, preserve standard input/accessibility behavior, and record its existing-card owner; visual branding alone is never justification.

    Liquid Glass is system-controlled on supported stable runtimes. Native controls may adopt it automatically; ordinary work/content surfaces remain opaque or semantic and S10-branded. Reject app-authored stacked materials, glass-on-glass, decorative `.glassEffect`, iOS-18 imitation, or stable-to-beta pixel matching. The built `Info.plist` must prove `UIDesignRequiresCompatibility` absent or `NO`; because Apple describes that escape hatch as temporary and ignores it for builds using the iOS 27 SDK, it is never the architecture. Do not mix incompatible material families to force visual sameness.

    Every bounded common journey freezes semantic—not pixel—continuity: typed route, task identity, visible primary action, safe resume anchor, accessibility identity, and prior-release/accepted-pre-release fallback. V21-P00-C08 is the sole definition owner for each journey's starting fixture/preconditions, ordered checkpoints, explicit branches, endpoint, invariants, back/cancel/resume/focus/fallback behavior, evidence layers, and implementing owners. There is one ID-based union: `J01_FIRST_ENTRY`, `J02_REAL_WORKSPACE_CREATE_IMPORT_SELECT`, `J03_SITE_LOCATION_ASSET_CREATE_FIND_SCAN`, `J04_OFFLINE_PREPARE`, `J05_ROUND_START_RESUME`, `J06_EVIDENCE_CAPTURE_CURATE`, `J07_VALIDATION_INCOMPLETE_RESOLUTION`, `J08_COMPLETE_NEXT_CLOSE`, `J09_REPORT_PREVIEW_SHARE_EXPORT`, `J10_BACKUP_RESTORE_RECOVERY`, `J11_SETTINGS_ACCESSIBILITY_HELP`, `J12_PURCHASE_RESTORE`, `J13_DELETE_ERASE`, and `J14_PRACTICE_START_SWITCH_LEAVE`. Automated, pilot, accessibility, restoration, and upgrade evidence bind the same journey-release and fixture digests. Every ID requires automated semantic evidence; V21-P05-C02 additionally exercises J01–J11 and J14 uncoached within its bounded noncustomer protocol, while J12 and J13 require their named owner/external-effect evidence. Every required layer/task must be `PASS`; `FAIL | NOT_RUN | STOPPED_SAFETY` blocks release, and `NOT_APPLICABLE_WITH_RATIONALE` is invalid for a required layer/task. Material friction may be `ACCEPT_WITH_RATIONALE` only when the task remains `PASS` against its frozen success endpoint. A justified relocation requires one `NavigationChangeDispositionV1`, compatible route/fallback behavior, a build-bound change notice where user behavior changes, upgrade fixtures, and no-regression evidence. Cosmetic modernization never silently moves a common task.

    `InteractionRecipeV1` maps IDLE, ACKNOWLEDGED, RUNNING_INDETERMINATE, RUNNING_DETERMINATE, STALLED_RECOVERABLE, STALLED_BLOCKED, LOCALLY_DURABLE, COMPLETED, BLOCKED, RETRYABLE_FAILURE, RECOVERY_REQUIRED, CANCELLED, and STALE_COMPLETION to one accessible visual/text/focus behavior. Specialized C36 draft states remain authoritative and map into—not duplicate—this presentation grammar. A press acknowledges in `<100 ms`, but Saved/Complete/success waits for the owning receipt and canonical read-back. Each registered long operation declares a budget-derived initial-stall threshold and progress-heartbeat SLA, exposes retry/cancel only when semantically safe, and keeps prior content where safe. Retry creates a successor operation token; cancellation or supersession prevents a late completion from stealing UI/focus, while any already-committed canonical effect is reconciled from its receipt/read-back. No whole-screen unexplained spinner, stale success, or duplicated effect is permitted.

    Motion uses system transitions first and only explains hierarchy, continuity, or state change. It is brief, interruptible, omitted from high-frequency field steps, and replaced under Reduce Motion by a highlight, dissolve, or immediate update without losing meaning. Haptics use system semantic patterns sparsely after a user-caused, receipt-confirmed discrete result or important warning; they never fire during camera/microphone/precision-sensor capture, never communicate alone, and need no custom Core Haptics engine or branded sound. One global device-local haptic preference in P02-C10's sole settings adapter can disable all app-authored haptics; there is no per-feature preference or duplicate engine. App-preference-off, runtime-unavailable/no-op, and unsafe-capture-context states preserve text, icon, VoiceOver, and Voice Control truth. Tests prove policy and generator invocation/noninvocation, never detection of an iOS-wide setting or physical sensation.

    The shared content grammar uses concise action verbs, nonblaming explanations, one concrete recovery action, and advanced-only support codes. Empty states explain the state and offer one useful next action. One user-initiated `submitAttemptID` freezes one validation snapshot: inline errors remain associated with their controls, the multi-error summary announces once, the first invalid control is revealed, and semantic/keyboard focus moves exactly once. Typing, passive validation recomputation, and background refresh preserve focus; explicit sheet dismissal restores the valid invoker or declared safe successor. Keyboard, paste, dictation/manual fallback, RTL, external keyboard, VoiceOver, Voice Control, Switch Control, `LARGER_TEXT_200_PERCENT`, and `DYNAMIC_TYPE_AX5` must have parity, with no hidden gesture-only action or validation trap.

    Safe recent-entry assistance is explicit and reviewable. A package may opt in only bounded enum option IDs or stable local references classified low risk. `RecentInputMemoryV1` is device-local in P02-C10's sole preferences adapter, keyed by WorkspaceID and semantic field ID, limited to three suggestions per field, 128 total LRU entries, and a 90-day TTL; it is excluded from workspace truth, backup, archive/export, journal, reports, search, diagnostics, C43 analytics, and cross-workspace use, and it is clearable plus Reset/Erase governed. It never stores raw free text, contact/email/address data, measurement, condition, pass/fail, finding, severity, evidence, sign-off, qualification, timestamp-as-observation, or hidden field. Every suggestion is revalidated both before display and at explicit acceptance against current workspace, package/release, field, option/reference, permission/availability, read-only state, and expected revision. Tombstoned, moved, retired, hidden, expired, corrupt, or otherwise invalid entries are pruned or hidden and never become truth; acceptance still uses the normal command/writer path.

    Evidence curation uses one pipeline: C36 stages each captured/imported item independently and makes an immediate local thumbnail available without waiting for sibling processing; P04-C02 owns explicit user order, bounded `CONTEXT | DETAIL | BEFORE | AFTER | OTHER` role, caption, optional accessibility description, retake/remove, and reversible arrow/circle/text annotation derivative. Before promotion, Retake/Remove discards or supersedes only the staged item under C36. After promotion, retake stages a new immutable original and an append-only successor sequence/association; remove creates a successor sequence that excludes the item without deleting its original. Finalized report bytes never change; a later change produces a new report version. Privacy redaction remains P03-C20 and cannot be confused with annotation. Reports consume explicit role/order; filenames and AI-invented descriptions never become accessibility truth.

    P04-C16's immutable bundled/versioned `ContextualGuidanceCatalogV1` owns `ContextualHelpEntryV1` source entries. Its nonpersistent `ContextualGuidanceProjectionV1` is rebuilt from that catalog plus accepted package guidance, current feature availability, typed route/screen, requirement explanations, and support/recovery routes. A short Why / what is saved / manual fallback explanation is reachable within two actions and may link to one offline Help surface. The projection has no migration, backup, export, journal, or workspace identity and creates no new tab, remote CMS, required coachmark, onboarding database, legal/professional advice, or duplicate package content; required safety/completion truth remains visible in the workflow itself.

    Site means a physical service boundary. Optional `ServicePartyReferenceV1` rows describe people or organizations and append-only Site roles such as OWNER, OPERATOR, CLIENT, SERVICE_PROVIDER, and CONTACT; they never become workspace identity, login, authorization, or CRM. `LocalActorReferenceV1` and frozen `ActorSnapshotV1`/`QualificationSnapshotV1` distinguish performed, recorded, observed, reviewed, verified, approved, acknowledged, assigned, and witnessed responsibilities. A self-declared or imported credential is labeled as such; profile edits or later expiry never rewrite historic sign-off.

    An Asset keeps one canonical AssetID independent of display code, manufacturer, model, serial, part, lot, UPC, semantic kind, placement, or workflow package. Package-qualified asset kinds and compatible workflow-package binding events are versioned; unknown and duplicate manufacturer identifiers remain valid explicit states. Reclassification and replacement lifecycle entries only reference their canonical kind-binding/successor-link facts, and each pair commits atomically under one MutationID so no duplicate truth can drift. Retirement and predecessor/successor lifecycle history append; operational return-to-service remains solely V21-P03-C04-owned. Every completed activity freezes a bounded `WorkSubjectScopeSnapshotV1` so a maintained asset, physical area, counting unit, and relationship are never assumed identical.

    Structural composition remains one-parent and bounded under C35. C39 owns semantic-kind capability tags only; C35 alone owns structural-composition policy and C41 alone owns functional endpoint/direction/cardinality/self-edge/cycle/traversal/Site policy. C41 descriptors bind exact C39 semantic releases without duplicating endpoint lists. Maximum/cycle/workspace constraints apply at mutation; minimum cardinality applies only at named readiness/finalization or atomic creation, so incomplete drafts/migrations are `INCOMPLETE`, not corrupt. Associations append/end/supersede and never imply ownership, placement, cascade deletion, identity merge, or authorization. Completed work freezes its topology interpretation. C37 additionally owns a point-only WGS84 `SpatialAnchorObservationV1` with source, reduced/full accuracy, uncertainty, simulated-source flag, exact placement episode, and append-only history; no map, polygon, route, tracking, geofence, or survey-grade claim follows.

    Criteria are exact, versioned assessment inputs—not universal law. C40 records source/edition/addenda, source type, adoption/contract/owner-policy basis, jurisdiction context selected by a person, license/storage disposition, exact locator/digest when lawful, applicability, measurement protocol, evaluator/version, unit/rounding policy, and package-owned severity scale. Multiple or conflicting sources remain visible. Reports say “assessed against” and use `MEETS_SCREENING_CRITERION | DOES_NOT_MEET | INCONCLUSIVE | NOT_EVALUATED`; they do not originate SAFE, COMPLIANT, CERTIFIED, legal precedence, or professional qualification claims.

    C43 separates four measurement sources that must never be silently joined: Apple-provided privacy-thresholded App Store aggregates; explicit owner-run field research; a future rebuildable operational-receipt projection contract; and any future consented product analytics. In V21 the receipt projection is descriptor plus synthetic TestSupport evaluator only—no production receipt reader, scheduler, persisted projection, UI, export, or runtime invocation—and existing operational receipts are not repurposed as analytics. The accepted V21 release candidate must ship product analytics as `DISABLED_NO_COLLECTION` and include no analytics/attribution SDK, endpoint, background uploader, advertising identifier, fingerprint, stable cross-app/device person ID, or raw event store. `CustomerLearningQuestionV1`, `CustomerLearningMetricDefinitionV1`, `AcquisitionSourceVocabularyV1`, `MeasurementPurposeV1`, and `MeasurementActivationDecisionV1` make future questions and formulas stable without binding AssetRounds to a vendor. C43's `CustomerLearningMetricDefinitionV1` is purpose-separated from P04-C09's shipping operational `MetricDefinitionV1`; V21 permits no typealias, adapter, import, projection, protocol conformance, shared registry, or identity conversion between them. Customer-learning definitions freeze numerator, denominator, eligibility, exclusions, window, source, privacy threshold, missingness, and noncausal interpretation; Practice and synthetic fixtures are excluded. App Store campaign links and source reports remain owner-operated App Store Connect inputs rather than app telemetry.

    Any future activation is a new owner-approved implementation card. It must name one decision the data will change, prove data minimization, legal/privacy/consent basis, App Privacy and policy updates, retention/deletion/export/withdrawal behavior, destination and processor review, offline/failure semantics, security/threat-model delta, exact release membership, and a kill/removal path. A remote flag, bundled policy change, or analytics vendor installation cannot activate collection. When disabled, archive/network/binary/runtime scans and a hostile test prove zero collection and zero transmission.

    C44 prevents operational contact data from becoming marketing data by accident. A Party/Site email, purchase, app use, support request, report share, feedback handoff, or research conversation grants no newsletter or advertising permission. A MarketingContact may arise only from independent affirmative newsletter, product-update, or research-invitation enrollment; TRANSACTIONAL_OR_SUPPORT is an operational exclusion/routing class and never creates a marketing contact, consent, preference, or suppression row. A future consent record preserves the exact entered/deliverable address plus a versioned comparison policy; it never strips plus tags or assumes case/Unicode equivalence, and collisions require review. Future suppression uses a reviewed service-side keyed token—not a plain hash—and remains Contact Info/personal data under a minimum-retention policy. The accepted V21 release candidate must ship no public signup, subscriber database, provider adapter implementation, credential, backend, send action, or release claim. Any future activation requires a controlled backend or provider-hosted signup and its own owner-approved privacy/security/release card; credentials never enter the iOS app. Except for the independently consented address/channel required for future delivery, a provider may never receive an operational contact record, physical/service address, Site, asset, relationship, note, photo, evidence, report, GPS, barcode, or work history. Ad-network retargeting/lookalikes remain a separate tracking decision.

    Every editable **workspace field/media** workflow uses C36's receipt-gated automatic checkpoint and item-level attachment staging; no feature may invent a Save/Sync queue. The bounded bootstrap-capable P04-C01 `SupportFeedbackDraftV1` in P02-C08's one device-operational support store is the sole non-workspace exception, not a reusable draft engine. Every sign/luminaire/plan/survey/round/scan-to-work consumer uses C37's one accessible anchor/pose editor where a package-derived component applies, or explicitly records NOT_OBSERVED with a closed reason; package-derived NOT_APPLICABLE creates no event. Required components remain incomplete until observed, and no screen may persist decorative rotation or a map pin as truth. Reports expose only bounded versioned profiles. Search/scanning preserve context and require explicit confirmation for duplicate/related-work actions. The first-real-job conductor is a rebuildable Today projection, not a compulsory onboarding funnel or second state store.

    The iPhone release has exactly four permanent roots:

    - **Today:** continue, exact next action, due/overdue work, readiness/recovery warnings, scan/start.
    - **Work:** active work, rounds, surveys, repairs, explicit activity-kind badges.
    - **Assets:** hierarchy/breadcrumb, search, scan, list/plans, history, references, issues, contextual start.
    - **Reports:** drafts, frozen reports, generation, export/share.

    Settings has Workspace & Packages, Field Capabilities, Data & Recovery, Subscription, Accessibility & Language, Help & Diagnostics, About, and an isolated Danger Zone—never another tab. Data & Recovery owns the one Support & Recovery Center; Today/startup/Help use its typed route and existing recovery authorities. Packages add closed content/actions, never a root, writer, database, report engine, settings tree, or visual system.

    First launch prompts for no permission: primary `Start a new workspace`; secondary `Try a practice round`; secondary `Other options` with `Restore from backup`/`Decide later`. The existing device-local first-real-job dismissal descriptor records Decide later so onboarding does not replay; Reset Settings preserves it, Erase clears it, and setup can be reopened explicitly. Practice data is explicit, synthetic, watermarked `PRACTICE — NOT FOR FIELD USE`, fully offline, installed through the normal writer/store into an isolated WorkspaceID, backed up with its classification, excluded from customer metrics, and removed only through the explicit `Reset Practice` action without changing real-workspace bytes. Switching flushes or truthfully blocks on the REAL draft, carries no workspace-scoped route/search state into Practice, and returns only to a validated REAL anchor or Today. Configuration reuse is preview-first and copies configuration only into a new real workspace. Existing/upgraded users never receive Practice data or replay onboarding silently.

    Restoration precedence is fail-closed startup recovery → incomplete authoritative mutation recovery → explicit deep link/App Intent/user activity → valid lightweight scene snapshot → Today. A restored route may offer Resume but never restarts capture, mutation, finalization, purchase, export, or share.

    ## 8. Persistence, identity, location, and history law

    - Stable workspace/site/location/asset/party/actor/entity/replica/mutation/receipt IDs are opaque; display names, barcodes, manufacturer identifiers, external keys, credentials, and breadcrumbs are attributes.
    - Site is the physical service/installation/inspection root, not customer, tenant, login, or legal entity. Location nodes are bounded descendants; `nil` location means known at Site scope. Optional party assignments and actor references append independently. Bounded one-parent asset composition is for independently maintained components only; C41's separately typed functional associations never turn it into EAV or an arbitrary unbounded graph.
    - Every asset-binding or reviewed physical-placement change appends a placement event and freezes the path used by completed work. Pure location label/code/order edits append hierarchy history and rebuild current path projections only—no per-asset placement, episode, or pose fan-out. `PhysicalPlacementEpisodeIDV1` is separate from hierarchy: a physical/cross-site move starts a new episode, a reviewed hierarchy-only reparent that changes bindings may preserve `SAME_PHYSICAL_INSTALLATION` and append successors, and unknown continuity blocks for review. One reviewed operation-level disposition may cover a homogeneous frozen subtree set; mixed cases remain per asset. Rename/reparent/move never rewrites finalized reports or old placement paths.
    - Point anchors and pose are immutable `OBSERVED | NOT_OBSERVED` histories bound to an exact placement event/physical episode. OBSERVED requires a qualified value/frame; NOT_OBSERVED carries no coordinate/angle and preserves reason/source/time. Point-only WGS84 observations freeze method, accuracy mode, horizontal/vertical accuracy, uncertainty, and simulated-source status. `UNKNOWN`, `PLAN_RELATIVE`, `TRUE_BEARING`, and `MAGNETIC_BEARING` pose frames remain distinct. C35's sole move coordinator and C29's sole rebase coordinator consume pure C37 components and emit one receipt each. Same-installation binding change appends a carry-forward successor; physical move defaults NOT_OBSERVED. Only the frozen coordinate/atan2/rounding/threshold policy may transform PLAN_RELATIVE azimuth under a qualified orientation-preserving 2-D similarity; geographic points never move through a plan rebase. Reflection, shear, nonuniform/perspective, singular, or excess-residual transforms require review. No background tracking, map, polygon, route, geofence, GIS provider, or survey-grade claim is implied.
    - `WorkflowNodeKindV1` is exactly SECTION, INSTRUCTION, FACT, EVIDENCE_REQUEST, BRANCH, REPEAT_GROUP, REVIEW, or TERMINAL with one kind-specific payload and exact outgoing cardinality. `BranchPredicateV1` is a depth/operand-bounded AST over already dominated stable fact/option IDs using EXISTS, IS_KNOWN, EQUALS, IN_SET, COMPARE_FIXED, NOT, ALL, and ANY. Evaluation is TRUE/FALSE/UNKNOWN with exactly one matching or default destination; multiple matches, no legal destination, forward references, unbounded recursion, or arbitrary graph cycles are invalid. Repeats are bounded first-class bodies keyed by `RepeatInstanceID`, never array position. Upstream edits append an invalidation receipt: now-inactive values remain historical as `INACTIVE_BY_PATH`, do not satisfy completion/reporting, and require explicit review if reactivated. No hidden-required trap, regex, script, or executable package code is allowed.
    - `ResponseValueV1` is a closed sum type covering no-value/not-applicable, Boolean/tri-state choice, single/multiple option IDs, bounded text, date/time/instant/duration, exact integer, exact decimal/measurement, stable entity/reference, and content reference as declared by the field definition. Measurement persistence retains entered mantissa/scale/unit separately from canonical value. The versioned allowlisted UCUM-compatible subset declares dimension plus exact rational/affine conversion, fixed-point range, precision/uncertainty, and ties-to-even rounding receipt; cross-dimension, unsupported unit/version, overflow, ambiguous offset, or Float/Double canonical persistence fails closed.
    - Finding severity, criterion screening, human operational disposition, corrective action, and compliance are separate facts. `OperationalDispositionEventV1` is append-only and bounded to IN_SERVICE_RECORDED, RESTRICTED_USE_RECORDED, OUT_OF_SERVICE_RECORDED, RETURNED_TO_SERVICE_RECORDED, and UNKNOWN_REVIEW_REQUIRED. It binds actor/authority/reason/finding/evidence revisions/effective time. Severity never changes service state automatically; completing repair never returns an asset to service; critical unresolved work requires explicit handoff/acknowledgement or remains incomplete.
    - Deleting the last asset does not delete its Site. Location/site removal is independently previewed and cannot cascade through asset/work/report history.
    - Every persistent kind enrolls before first write in migration, backup/restore, delete/Erase, archive/export, search/rebuild, journal/replay, localization/frozen display, privacy/retention, interruption, and downgrade/forward-fix ownership.
    - One `PersistentSchemaReleaseRegistryV1` serializes concrete canonical SwiftData version allocation; canonical store-shape writers take a global exclusive lease even when five CI slots are available. Separately versioned device-local operational stores use their own sole serialized owner/migration/lifecycle authority. Compatibility cases are appended before first write and cover every supported skipped-version path.
    - Every shipped public version becomes an immutable compatibility case. Unknown future data fails closed before source mutation.
    - `RecoveryPointStatusV1` compares one archive's verified WorkspaceID/revision frontier, checkpoint, content/draft/staging/reservation coverage, digest, creation time, verification time, and verifier with the current canonical frontier. Closed states are NEVER_CREATED, CREATING, VALIDATION_FAILED, VERIFIED_CURRENT, VERIFIED_BEHIND, UNVERIFIED, FILE_UNAVAILABLE, and EXTERNAL_AVAILABILITY_UNKNOWN. Revision delta is truth; wall-clock age is advisory under C07 time semantics. A successful share-sheet handoff never proves external retention. UI says “verified through revision/time; N later changes” and never “safe” or “synced.”
    - Every app-owned production SwiftData configuration and test mirror explicitly passes `cloudKitDatabase: .none`; no convenience/default container may infer managed sync from entitlements. `REPLICATED` means future transport eligibility only, and every inbound effect must still enter through accepted envelopes and `WorkspaceWriter`.
    - Replica conflict identity and resolution basis are order-independent: stable subject/policy plus a canonically sorted competing MutationID/input-digest set, exact causal/base frontier, and policy digest. Destination receipt IDs, arrival/journal order, wall time, and local sequence never enter identity/convergence. A resolution delivered before its named inputs waits; a late third competitor creates a deterministic successor conflict rather than changing the frozen resolved set.
    - Semantic reversal is a new compensating mutation. Erase, finalized artifacts, accepted package releases, purged originals, and external share effects are never silently “undone.”
    - C36 promotion is a receipt-backed saga, not a cross-filesystem/database transaction: PREPARED → content promoted under the sole exact unbound reservation → P02-C02 atomic target effect/receipt → canonical read-back → idempotent draft retirement. Exact retries reuse the reservation; changed/discarded input quarantines and reconciles it. Backup takes a bounded stable-edge snapshot containing every necessary reservation/unbound original. Autosave has 750-ms trailing and five-second continuous-edit bounds, and one closed UI state set covers unsaved through discarded with receipt/read-back truth. Draft/base compare-and-swap failures retain the original and require explicit review/rebase, commit-as-copy, continue-editing, or discard—never silent merge.
    - P02-C08 owns one separately versioned, protected, backup-excluded, size-bounded device-operational support store. It uses explicit `.none` if SwiftData-backed and is the only persistence for P04-C01's bootstrap feedback exception; corruption/upgrade/Erase and a no-other-draft-store scan are mandatory.

    ## 9. Release platform, privacy, commerce, and diagnostics law

    - The V21 candidate is iPhone-native (`UIDeviceFamily=[1]`). Do not add family 2 or native-iPad metadata/screenshots/accessibility claims; run only the bounded compatibility-mode smoke and resolve Mac/Apple Vision Pro availability explicitly. C06's dated Apple snapshot also owns actual scene-lifecycle, conditional source→built-plist→clean-install launch-screen, and conditional compatibility-resizability dispositions. When the accepted shipping SDK activates those rules, test arbitrary required bounds/size classes, safe areas, native toolbar overflow/minimization, keyboard/rotation/common tasks, and reject `UIScreen.main` sizing assumptions; this remains compatibility evidence, not native-iPad scope.
    - Keep exactly one app-bundle-root privacy manifest; preserve correctly placed dependency/framework manifests and reconcile Required Reason use per owning bundle.
    - A release requires one live HTTPS privacy-policy URL and the same accessible in-app Privacy & Data policy version covering collection, sharing/third parties, retention, deletion/Erase, revocation, contact, and changes. C06 and automated P05-C01 may carry `DRAFT_LOCAL` with owner fields `NOT_RUN` only as an explicit release blocker and with no release-readiness claim; P05-C02 and actual release require `LIVE_MATCHED`.
    - Permissions occur at deliberate first use, have localized purpose strings and complete manual paths, and never falsely satisfy a package requirement.
    - Default to zero new SDKs. Any dependency requires exact source/pin, license, privacy/transitive/repackaging/removal inventory; Apple's current covered SDKs need required manifests and listed/repackaged binary SDKs need signer continuity. Any third party receiving user data must provide equal protection.
    - Preserve existing StoreKit identifiers and processing. `AppStore.sync()` is explicit-Restore-only; startup uses current entitlements/updates/unfinished transactions. Test purchase/restore/renewal/lapse/refund/revocation and paywall/Terms/Privacy disclosures; commercial loss never hides or destroys prior data.
    - An archive proves the default data-protection entitlement, not sandbox-file attributes. Installed-runtime evidence verifies per-kind `fileProtectionKey`, ownership, and policy-accurate backup eligibility/exclusion after file operations. Physical locked-device behavior may remain `REQUIRED_PENDING_OWNER` until P05-C02 but must pass before release.
    - Preserve local system-health diagnostics. Workflow-friction aggregates remain separately optional/default-off. No third-party analytics or crash SDK is required.
    - P00-C02 owns a build-bound `ReleaseThreatModelV1` and `PrivacyDataFlowManifestV1` covering malicious packages/imports/archives/deep links, path traversal, decompression/resource exhaustion, tampered evidence, shared-device/export leakage, future measurement activation, and release artifacts. P05-C01 recomputes them from the exact candidate; documentation is not a substitute for executable hostile cases.
    - Customer-learning/product/acquisition collection remains `DISABLED_NO_COLLECTION`. The Release binary contains no analytics/attribution SDK, endpoint, advertising identifier, fingerprinting, background telemetry, user-event store, or production operational-receipt analytics invoker/projection. Apple App Store Connect's aggregate acquisition/campaign/usage reports and explicit owner research remain outside canonical customer work. Any future collection or production receipt repurposing requires a new owner-approved card and complete privacy, consent, retention, deletion/export, processor, threat-model, App Privacy, and release proof; C43 itself cannot activate it.
    - Customer communications/research participation remains `DISABLED_NO_SUBSCRIBER_COLLECTION_OR_TRANSMISSION`. Operational contacts and transactional/support channels are never enrolled automatically. Release contains no signup, subscriber list, email-provider SDK/credential/endpoint, backend, send queue, or marketing audience export. C44's static consent/preference/suppression schemas cannot activate delivery; a future service must preserve exact-address/comparison policy, withdrawal, keyed-token suppression, and deletion/reimport behavior while keeping first-party communications distinct from ad-network tracking.
    - Dormant C43/C44 schemas and synthetic fixtures do not themselves constitute collection. P05-C01 must separately prove (a) zero C43/C44 developer- or processor-directed collection/transmission and zero tracking, and (b) that the candidate's complete actual data flows—including Apple services and explicit user-directed export/share/support handoff—remain accurately represented by the privacy policy and App Privacy answers. If the complete reconciliation still supports the current Data Not Collected/no-tracking posture, preserve it; do not declare Contact Info, Analytics, or Developer Advertising/Marketing solely because static types exist. Any actual C43/C44 collection, provider transmission, or tracking flow fails the candidate pending the later activation card and owner reconciliation; unrelated accepted flows are classified by their actual behavior.
    - Production OSLog/signpost emission goes through one registry-backed adapter. Static operational codes and bounded counts are allowed; customer text, notes, paths, locations, stable IDs, secrets, and raw errors are forbidden. Release scans also reject `print`, `debugPrint`, `dump`, and `NSLog` outside exact test/CLI allowlists. Logs remain noncanonical OS-managed effects and are never included in support export.
    - Support export is previewed and explicit; no automatic upload and no customer notes/media/locations/paths/IDs/secrets by default.

    ## 10. Architecture, test, and GitHub Actions efficiency

    - One composition root; commands/queries into views; platform adapters return typed results; one WorkspaceWriter owns canonical mutation.
    - Every dossier declares complete `ExecutionAuthorityV1`: executor actor, evidence producer, decision owner, external-mutation owner, acceptance mechanism, sign-off actor, and exact owner-input condition. C05 rejects omissions or an “acceptor” field that conflates a person with a mechanism.
    - Card head grammar is base `B` → implementation head `I` → external acceptance-run receipt bound to `I` → optional authority/handoff-only descendant `H`. `I` remains the accepted implementation head; `H` is the continuation head only when governed evidence reuse proves the `I..H` diff is allowlisted and every governed input is equal. A commit is never required to record its own future SHA or CI run ID.
    - Cards integrate serially on the current phase branch. Only the designated phase closure fast-forwards fetched `origin/main` after proving it still equals the recorded phase base. `PhaseIntegrationReceiptV1` binds base, closure, prior main, resulting main, and `FAST_FORWARD_ONLY`; drift fails closed and requires ancestry reconciliation plus affected reproof. Never merge/rebase/cherry-pick an artifact-bound P05 candidate.
    - `PlanningCardStatusV1` is immutable planning provenance. `CardExecutionStatusV1` is a separate receipt-derived coordination/runtime projection over all 128 rows; its full implementation/CI path applies only to `IMPLEMENT_NOW`, `IMPLEMENT_TOOLING_NOW`, and `PREPARE_NOW` cards plus accepted-dependency corrections, and the auxiliary P05-C01 transport refresh is outside this state machine. Its closed states are PREFLIGHT, READY, IMPLEMENTING, CI_PENDING, INFRASTRUCTURE_PENDING, ACCEPTANCE_FAILED, DIAGNOSTIC_COMPLETE_NON_ACCEPTING, CORRECTION_REQUIRED, ACCEPTED_IMPLEMENTATION, HANDOFF_PENDING, COMPLETE, OWNER_PENDING, DEFERRED, and SUPERSEDED. Every nondeferred row with no current receipt derives PREFLIGHT even when not yet eligible; PREFLIGHT never means runnable. For `VALIDATE_NEXT`, `DEFER`, `OWNER_ACTION`, and `MONITOR`, `CardExecutionStatusV1` is only a coordination projection: those rows use the PREFLIGHT/OWNER_PENDING/DEFERRED/SUPERSEDED subset as applicable, their dossier-specific activation/disposition/receipt is terminal truth, and they never enter ACCEPTED_IMPLEMENTATION or COMPLETE through this table. Allowed edges are PREFLIGHT→READY/OWNER_PENDING/DEFERRED/SUPERSEDED; READY→IMPLEMENTING/OWNER_PENDING/DEFERRED/SUPERSEDED; IMPLEMENTING→CI_PENDING/CORRECTION_REQUIRED/INFRASTRUCTURE_PENDING/OWNER_PENDING/SUPERSEDED; CI_PENDING→ACCEPTANCE_FAILED/ACCEPTED_IMPLEMENTATION/INFRASTRUCTURE_PENDING/SUPERSEDED; ACCEPTANCE_FAILED→DIAGNOSTIC_COMPLETE_NON_ACCEPTING/CORRECTION_REQUIRED/INFRASTRUCTURE_PENDING/OWNER_PENDING/SUPERSEDED; DIAGNOSTIC_COMPLETE_NON_ACCEPTING→CORRECTION_REQUIRED/INFRASTRUCTURE_PENDING/OWNER_PENDING/SUPERSEDED only; CORRECTION_REQUIRED→IMPLEMENTING/OWNER_PENDING/SUPERSEDED; INFRASTRUCTURE_PENDING→its receipt-recorded resumable predecessor/successor state, OWNER_PENDING, or SUPERSEDED; ACCEPTED_IMPLEMENTATION→HANDOFF_PENDING/COMPLETE; HANDOFF_PENDING→COMPLETE/INFRASTRUCTURE_PENDING/SUPERSEDED; OWNER_PENDING→its receipt-recorded resume state/DEFERRED/SUPERSEDED; DEFERRED→PREFLIGHT only with an explicit owner re-entry receipt, or SUPERSEDED; COMPLETE→SUPERSEDED only through the accepted dependency-correction law; SUPERSEDED is terminal for that attempt and a successor attempt begins at PREFLIGHT. Every unlisted edge fails closed. Typed progress events bind exact program/card/branch/base/head/tree/state/actor/receipt/run/blocker/unaffected-continuation/next-action data.
    - ContractManifestV1 remains the sole normative open-contract source. P03-C06 deterministically derives checked-in JSON Schema Draft 2020-12 through exact hydrated generator/schema/resource/project paths, and P03-C10's separately pinned non-Swift TestSupport validator/decoder proves the positive/hostile corpus without becoming production truth or Release code.
    - Use closure clients or narrow protocols at volatile boundaries. Do not create speculative micro-modules; ratchet inherited exceptions and measure before physical extraction.
    - Move all UI-test scenario setup into isolated TestSupport. Release builds contain no test deletion route, fixture controller, phase flag, or fault injector.
    - Adopt Swift 6 in stages: Swift 5 Complete checking → root-cause fixes/unsafe inventory → zero diagnostics → Swift 6 all targets/configurations → full reproof.
    - Check in FastPR, ReleaseCandidate, StoreKitRegression, Sanitizers, and DiagnosticSweep. The first four provide selected fail-fast gating evidence; DiagnosticSweep alone is permanently non-accepting. New UI tests use typed scenarios/page robots; retain a small real E2E set.
    - A cheap Ubuntu sentinel precedes macOS. One build-for-testing producer packs `.xctestproducts` with tar/ditto so modes/symlinks/case survive artifact transport; one-to-five adaptive test-without-building shards reuse it only when effective build identity and compiled inventory match. Sanitizers/instrumentation use distinct artifacts.
    - Private system discovery uses one named protected custom Core Spotlight index, never the default production index. Its device-local default-OFF setting selects a bounded set of real workspaces; Practice is always excluded. One serialized client-state blob holds a sorted per-workspace revision/projection/deletion-frontier map, and opaque identifiers include WorkspaceID so multiple workspaces cannot collide. It is derived, allowlisted, and immediately route-blocked on disable/tombstone/Erase; deletion completion is recorded truthfully as `REMOVAL_JOURNALED`, not physical erasure.
    - Optional prepared capabilities are controlled only by one schema-validated immutable policy resource covered by the signed build. There is no remote config, cohort switch, Release environment override, or flag that hides prior work/recovery/delete/Erase.
    - One trusted default-branch controller owns five job-level hosted Actions slot groups with no authoritative queue or placeholder run. Every slot uses `queue: max` without `cancel-in-progress: true`: at most one member runs, the exact inventory-bounded typed pending set is retained, and any nonempty group is unavailable to new controller admission. Pending work owns no active lease or unique authority; correctness never relies on queue order, and an unbound/above-bound/100-member/capacity-canceled state fails closed. When the running controller owns slot 1 and slots 2–5 are occupied, it may emit exactly one `DeclaredSlot1SuccessorReservationV1` for an already-declared dependency-ready `needs: controller` job. This is controller output/planning evidence only—not GitHub pending-set membership and not a lease—because the dependent job cannot resolve `needs` or enter its concurrency group until control completes. After the controller exits, that job alone may resolve the reservation and then be observed/admitted as pending or in progress in slot 1. If no such work exists the controller emits `CAPACITY_FULL` and creates no placeholder. If another job already owns slot 1, the controller may wait as typed `CAPACITY_WAITING` and emits no impossible in-job receipt. Declared later stages may join only their typed pending set after dependencies resolve. `RunnerCapacityManifestV1` keeps every GitHub-hosted job within five in progress. Every consumer/new hosted label is inventoried; multiplicity/API ambiguity fails closed. Least privilege and full-SHA pins are mandatory.
    - A minimal trusted completion/scheduled bridge uses slot 1, shares the explicit `queue: single` nonauthoritative workflow-level orchestration group, and never executes a batch. Only `DISPATCH_REQUIRED` creates a fresh API-2026-03-10 canonical `workflow_dispatch` and binds its HTTP-200 run ID/URLs; idle, duplicate, and fail-closed dispositions emit none. Protected release uses a separate fixed `queue: max` ledger group. The owner authorizer creates one explicit GitHub Deployment in non-protected `assetrounds-release-authorization-ledger`; the separate environment Deployment is linked but never authority. Atomic `SIGN_AND_UPLOAD | SUBMIT_FOR_REVIEW | PROMOTE_TESTED_BUILD` actions have distinct input schemas, idempotency keys, reconciliation, and owner authorizations. P05-C01 produces its exact no-source-rebuild `ReleaseMutationInputV1` during the accepting candidate run; only after the unchanged SHA/tree/build becomes accepted main may SIGN_AND_UPLOAD consume that original artifact. C06 first proves the exact-Xcode signing/package flow. Artifact retention covers the seven-day hard TTL plus a fixed two-hour margin, and authorization expiry cannot exceed artifact expiry minus that margin. The secret-bearing job uses only `contents:none`, `actions:read`, and `deployments:write`; it has no checkout/build/local script/downloaded executable and uses only inline trusted YAML or a full-SHA-pinned external action. Writers serialize, cancellation/reconciliation/reapproval remain closed, and P05-C02 commits the secret-free full chain at `docs/release/protected-release/<authorization-id>.json` before acceptance/90-day status expiry; P05-C03 re-verifies it.
    - Official acceptance is exact-head and fail-fast. After the first applicable deterministic failure, run at most one same-head non-accepting DiagnosticSweep over reachable affected cells, combine corrections only when the same renderer, demonstrated root cause, and normalized failure signature all match, rerun targeted acceptance, and reserve the next full matrix for the corrected final head. Unrelated causes retain separate correction heads/receipts.
    - V21-P00-C08 freezes one build-bound perceived-quality protocol with `PerformanceEvidenceTierV1 = AUTOMATED_SIMULATOR_REGRESSION | OWNER_PHYSICAL_RELEASE`. Record exact build/tree, tier, device/simulator profile, OS, power/thermal state where physically observable, fixture scale, refresh rate/frame interval, repeat count, signpost identity, and p50/p95/max. The inherited performance manifest/budget record's baseline-compatibility key must match metric/signpost schema, evidence tier, device/simulator profile, runtime class, fixture digest/scale, setup/reset protocol, power mode, and accessibility profile before comparison; otherwise the absolute ceiling gates and the run establishes a new baseline. This clarifies an existing record and adds no V21 contract. First useful state is meaningful interactive content or actionable recovery—not a launch frame, skeleton, placeholder, or hidden prewarm. Discrete main-thread response is `<100 ms`; each main-thread update/frame during continuous interaction completes within the measured display-refresh budget while the gesture itself may span many frames; critical callbacks target `<5 ms`. Cold p95 time-to-first-useful-state is the lower of two seconds or comparable accepted baseline +10%; if no comparable accepted baseline exists, the two-second absolute ceiling gates and the first accepted result becomes the successor baseline—missing or incompatible is never zero, PASS, or a fabricated comparison. The same absolute-only-first-baseline rule applies to every regression budget. Each accepting metric uses 20 measured repetitions; only a result within the predeclared ±5% boundary/noise band receives one additional batch of ten, recomputed over all 30. A still-ambiguous result is `INCONCLUSIVE_BLOCKED`, not PASS and not another same-head rerun. Every enabled app-authored action visibly acknowledges in `<100 ms`, and the exact critical-journey run permits zero detected hangs. Root switch, local asset/history open, indexed search first result, draft resume, capture preparation/local thumbnail, Complete & Next, import preview, report first-page preview, backup, and recovery each receive an absolute budget plus accepted-baseline regression ceiling. Pre-P05 `AUTOMATED_SIMULATOR_REGRESSION` can accept the owning implementation card with a visible `REQUIRED_PENDING_OWNER` physical row, but cannot support physical performance/energy/thermal/camera/usability claims. V21-P05-C02 must resolve `OWNER_PHYSICAL_RELEASE` on the oldest supported compatible physical iPhone; physical memory, disk writes, app size, energy, and thermal behavior use measured baselines rather than invented universal byte/joule limits. These checks refine V21-P02-C05/V21-P00-C08 and do not create analytics.
    - Representative journey fixtures include empty, ordinary, and declared maximum-scale canonical/media state. Keep prior content during scoped refresh where safe; never use a global spinner or fake shimmering skeleton for local reads. Blank/stuck UI, duplicate submission, keyboard obstruction, stale completion, success-before-receipt, main-actor N+1 work, or an unexplained budget regression blocks the owning card.
    - V21-A00 uses a dedicated clean worktree created from accepted exact `origin/main`; never switch or reuse a dirty/user-work worktree. It earns zero card credit. First commit immutable activation implementation head `I_A00` containing only installed authorities, provisional P00-C01 projection, and allowlisted bootstrap changes. Then an external `ProgramActivationReceiptV1` binds prior main, `I_A00` head/tree, all four document paths/hashes, branch creation, preserved-user-work manifest, actor, and result. If repository persistence is desired, a later authority-only `H_A00` may record the receipt but never names itself and must pass governed no-build-input reuse. C01 cannot become READY without the external ACTIVATED receipt. C04's trusted-controller bootstrap uses one logical checkpoint ID with append-only attempt IDs, so a correction never rewrites an earlier failed attempt already visible on main.
    - Prospectively, CURRENT_TASK is a bounded generated projection over append-only per-card attempt/receipt records with size budgets and stable links. Accepted S10 history is preserved; V21 does not keep growing one monolithic authority/test file when segmented fixtures and typed manifests can express the same proof.
    - Reuse across authority/handoff-only heads requires `GovernedEvidenceReuseReceiptV1` proving complete build/test/workflow/dependency/fixture/renderer/runtime/device equality. Durable semantic summaries outlive expiring artifacts. Never blind-rerun deterministic defects or blind-retry a lost dispatch.

    ## 11. Brand, localization, accessibility, and technical identity

    Ordinary V21 cards inherit the complete accepted S10.6 token/component/state inventory (67 states at planning observation only), accessibility semantics, and historic-report brand rules. They add only changed recipes and computed affected consumers.

    S10.6 visual-brand inheritance is immediate. The pre-S10.6 planning observation found no String Catalog, so V21-A00/P00-C01 re-audits the accepted S10.6 baseline. If an application catalog or semantic-ID registry then exists, P03-C16 adopts and extends that accepted owner; otherwise P03-C16 creates exactly one. Before P03-C16, cards preserve whichever accepted localization/ID seam exists, record new copy/ID deltas in `BrandImpactManifestV1`, and create neither a duplicate catalog nor new phase-prefixed IDs. Later cards consume P03-C16's localization/key/semantic-ID authority and P00-C08's content-pattern semantics; P04-C28 retires the shipping legacy allowlist, and P04-C29 freezes closure.

    P04-C27 inventories every accepted S10.6/original-app steady/transient state plus every state introduced by inherited V20 and added V21 scope, including the V18-origin feature delta, along with public vocabulary/technical identity, HIG disposition, native/custom controls, toolbar/menu/search structure, platform materials, content patterns, focus/keyboard, loading/progress, motion/haptics, scene background/return, and journey/performance evidence. P04-C28 corrects shared roots before consumers. P04-C29 runs one complete iPhone brand/interaction/accessibility/localization matrix with separate minimum-iOS-18 and `LATEST_ACCEPTED_STABLE_SHIPPING_RUNTIME` appearance profiles and semantic parity; the symbolic latest profile is re-resolved from C06's dated stable-runtime/scene-lifecycle snapshot before the run, and beta runtime evidence is diagnostic only. It then freezes the V21 candidate baseline. P05-C01 reuses exact matching evidence; it does not rerun an unchanged full matrix.

    Public AssetRounds copy, reports, exports, accessibility, support, and App Store drafts may change through the accepted vocabulary map. Bundle IDs, UTI/backup extension, storage roots, target/module identities, StoreKit product ID, schema/wire keys, and historic finalized bytes remain frozen unless a separate migration is authorized.

    One `Localizable.xcstrings` plus P00-C06-owned `InfoPlist.xcstrings` owns runtime and permission copy. P03-C16 freezes a no-growth legacy literal/phase-ID allowlist; P04-C28 migrates it; P04-C29 requires zero shipping phase IDs/unallowlisted literals and test-only aliases. Semantic accessibility IDs are stable across phase/order/locale/copy; dynamic suffixes use opaque IDs, never user content. Pseudo-locales are test-only. Every claimed App Store accessibility feature requires all common tasks and maps only to Apple’s nine fields.

    ## 12. Bootstrap and implementation order

    ### Entry gate

    Complete S10.4, S10.5, and S10.6 under live repository authority. Re-fetch and preserve user work. Create a separate clean V21 worktree and `phase/v21-p00-foundations` only from accepted S10.6 exact `origin/main`; never switch/reuse the active dirty S10 worktree.

    ### Foundation bootstrap

    1. `V21-A00` creates the dedicated clean worktree/`phase/v21-p00-foundations` from accepted exact-main S10.6 and installs/hash-pins the four delivered Markdown authorities at `docs/design/v21/` with unchanged filenames plus exact authority/current-task changes. It records a provisional first `BootstrapHydratedCardSpecV1` instance for P00-C01 inside `docs/execution/CURRENT_TASK.md`, then commits immutable `I_A00`. Only afterward does an external `ProgramActivationReceiptV1` bind `I_A00`; an optional repository `H_A00` is authority-only and cannot name itself. A00 is not a card, earns zero credit, and contains no product/schema/workflow/test change. C01's first check validates the external receipt and formalizes the bootstrap instance before any other C01 mutation. The instance is neither a generated projection nor a schema artifact; C05 later creates generated projections.
    2. `V21-P00-C01` alone captures the accepted baseline, the complete inherited V20 implementation scope, the closed 17-card added V21 scope, and direct V20→V21 HIG/planning-language/lineage reconciliation; this records planned scope and transfers no implementation credit.
    3. Execute `V21-P00-C02` to acceptance; only then does dependent `V21-P00-C04` become ready. Implement C04 separately and validate its dormant controller with the incumbent accepted CI.
    4. Use the one `C04TrustedControllerBootstrapCheckpointV1`: inventory every incumbent hosted job in `LegacyHostedJobTransitionManifestV1` and wait for zero legacy unleased `queued | pending | requested | waiting | in_progress` jobs without canceling older accepted work. Unknown/partial/new status fails closed. Then non-force fast-forward the exact incumbent-CI-green but not-yet-accepted C04 candidate—containing accepted C01/C02 ancestry and the dormant skeleton—to `main`. Re-fetch; prove every legacy hosted entry point on that exact head is converted to the controller or explicitly disabled without dropping required acceptance; inventory again; and wait for every job triggered by the fast-forward to reach a terminal state. Only after this second zero-legacy drain may the trusted default-branch workflow be invoked against the same SHA/tree. A green proof makes it C04's sole accepting head; failure stays in C04 correction lineage and repeats the checkpoint. Only then create the P00 continuation branch. This earns no extra card credit and is not P00 closure.
    5. `V21-P00-C05` installs the 128-card/lifecycle/receipt/authority validator and generated bounded execution projections.
    6. `V21-P00-C07` installs composition/test/Swift 6 closure, including removal of production test hooks.
    7. `V21-P00-C06` proves iPhone/release-platform/archive/orientation closure against the clean Release archive.
    8. `V21-P00-C08` freezes native-appearance, journey-continuity, content/interaction, motion/haptic, and perceived-quality contracts/harnesses and closes P00 without changing the accepted S10 brand direction.
    9. P01 C01–C06 establish data survival; P01-C07 freezes compatibility policy/corpus before P02/P03 expansion.
    10. P02 installs writer/reversal/jobs/health/capability foundations, including the sole safe recent-input storage policy.
    11. P03 executes the shared kernel through P03-C08 → P03-C11 → P03-C35 → P03-C09/C10 and the remaining dependency-ready contracts. C36 follows C16; C37 follows C29; C38–C41 install accountability/asset/criterion/association semantics; C42 installs the Release-excluded conformance corpus; C43 freezes the disabled measurement boundary; C44 freezes the disabled communications/consent boundary; C45–C51 add the label, operational-contact, installation/punch, portable-review, manual-resource, incumbent-adapter, and advanced-schedule contracts. P03-C34 closes only after every required P03 card including C35–C51.
    12. P04 launches shared workflows, evidence curation, import/settings/starter/help/support, the inherited feature families, and P04-C30–C39's complete V21 advancement surfaces before C27–C29.
    13. P04-C27/C28/C29 executes the sole second application-wide release-brand/interaction phase.
    14. P05-C01 proves one exact automated code/archive candidate. P05-C02 executes the owner field-usability/signing/submission gate; P05-C03 monitors only after release.

    No routine approval pause exists between accepted Codex-authorized cards. Emit each receipt/handoff and continue immediately to the next dependency-ready card. Missing optional research/brand/publication evidence disables only that gate. Stop only for the explicit owner-only conditions in Section 16.

    Use one phase branch at a time from verified exact main, with the sole V21-P00-C04 trusted-controller bootstrap exception above. Exact autonomous/release phase names are `phase/v21-p00-foundations`, `phase/v21-p00-foundations-continuation`, `phase/v21-p01-data-survival`, `phase/v21-p02-mutation-lifecycle`, `phase/v21-p03-shared-kernel`, `phase/v21-p04-release-workflows-brand`, and `phase/v21-p05-release-candidate`. P00 finally closes at C08; P01 at C07; P02 at C10; P03 at C34 after all required P03 cards including C35–C51; P04 at C29 after C30–C39; automated P05 at C01. Integrate cards serially on the phase branch and only phase closures fast-forward verified origin/main. Select the lowest register ordinal autonomous card with no current accepted COMPLETE receipt whose dependency/phase/authority predicate is true and whose receipt-derived runtime state is PREFLIGHT, READY, or CORRECTION_REQUIRED. The first exception to the current-phase and no-COMPLETE predicates is a receipt-triggered accepted-dependency correction: select its successor correction branch before every affected consumer regardless of the dependency's original phase, preserve/supersede its accepted receipt, award no second credit, and invalidate/reprove the declared downstream and P05-candidate closure. The second exception to the no-COMPLETE predicate is an auxiliary exact-main release-transport evidence operation, not a new card execution attempt or state. When `ReleaseMutationInputV1` expires or lacks the required margin, rerun the complete P05-C01 candidate matrix from current accepted exact main with no evidence reuse; emit a new immutable build/artifact identity and full-matrix-bound exact-head release transport/build acceptance receipt, then supersede only the expired transport binding. This transport refresh leaves P05-C01's COMPLETE receipt, accepted implementation head, graph credit, and governed product/source tree unchanged and creates no `CardExecutionStatusV1` transition. P05-C02 never rebuilds or relabels a candidate; any governed source, workflow, test, dependency, fixture, toolchain, or build-input change is not a transport refresh and instead uses accepted-dependency correction and fresh-candidate law. `INFRASTRUCTURE_PENDING` is selectable only after its recorded resumption predicate resolves it to the receipt-named state; `HANDOFF_PENDING` is selectable only for its allowed handoff-to-COMPLETE work and never to rerun implementation. Immutable `planningStatus` is provenance only and never drives runtime reselection. `VALIDATE_NEXT` and `DEFER` never auto-select, while `OWNER_ACTION` begins only after V21-P05-C01 and `MONITOR` becomes eligible only after V21-P05-C02 records RELEASED or PHASED_RELEASE_ACTIVE. In branch templates, `<card-suffix>` is the lowercase `pNN-cNN` portion of the canonical ID, without another `v21-` prefix. V21-P00-C03 alone may run serially on P00's branch while P00 remains open; after P00 closure it uses `validation/v21-<card-suffix>-<slug>` from then-current accepted exact main. P06 owns no ordinary phase branch: every owner-selected P06 VALIDATE_NEXT activation and owner-re-entered P06 DEFER study always uses a dedicated validation branch from then-current accepted exact main. Parallel preparation is allowed only for disjoint fences; integration and acceptance remain serial.

    A dedicated validation/re-entry branch never merges, fast-forwards, rebases, or cherry-picks into main or a released candidate. Its terminal proof is the dossier's `BOUNDED_VALIDATION_RECEIPT` or DEFER decision receipt bound to immutable branch head/tree; remove scratch/prototype output and retain only allowlisted evidence on that branch. Any later owner-authorized product implementation is newly implemented and reproved on then-current main and cannot import validation code or claim validation as implementation credit.

    Automated P05 closes at V21-P05-C01; that implementation head remains the immutable candidate/build identity. V21-P05-C02 records allowlisted owner/release evidence only on `evidence/v21-p05-c02-owner-release-<attempt>` from current accepted exact main, and V21-P05-C03 records append-only monitoring evidence only on `monitor/v21-p05-c03-<period>-<attempt>`. A non-force evidence-only integration requires `GovernedEvidenceReuseReceiptV1` plus `PhaseIntegrationReceiptV1` reason `AUTHORITY_ONLY_RELEASE_EVIDENCE`, proving candidate/product/workflow/test/build inputs unchanged. Neither branch may rebuild, relabel, or alter the V21-P05-C01 candidate; any build-input difference requires correction and a fresh candidate.

    The autonomous lane closes 115 cards: 102 `IMPLEMENT_NOW`, 5 `IMPLEMENT_TOOLING_NOW`, and 8 `PREPARE_NOW`. P05-C01 is one PREPARE card; all dependency-ready autonomous predecessors accept first. Physical-device rows may remain `REQUIRED_PENDING_OWNER` through the automated candidate with prohibited claims, but every mandatory release row must resolve in P05-C02.

    The register's `Planning status` column is immutable `PlanningCardStatusV1` provenance. It remains 125 NOT_STARTED / one BLOCKED_BY_ACTIVE_S10 / two DEFERRED even after execution begins. `CardExecutionStatusV1` is separately derived from bounded current-task projection and accepted receipts; it advances without rewriting planning history.

    ## 15. Exact V20 → V21 primary lineage

    Every one of V20's 111 cards appears exactly once as the same-suffix V21 successor. All earlier predecessors preserved by V20 remain transitive and fully represented by the self-contained V21 dossiers. No predecessor is dropped or credited as implemented. `EXACT_WITH_GENERATION_REBIND` marks 89 inherited cards with no card-specific change. `REFINED_WITHOUT_LOSS` marks 22 inherited cards that absorb integration, performance, durability, navigation, reporting, import, HIG, brand-freeze, physical-closure, advanced-validation, or release-proof consequences without surrendering an earlier requirement. `ADDED_V21` marks exactly 17 new cards with no predecessor and no implementation credit. The three groups total 128 unique V21 card identities.
