    ## 16. Autonomous authority and owner-only stops

    The owner authorizes Codex to continue through all dependency-ready V21 cards without routine approval for safe inspection, exact allowed-path edits, fixtures, formatting, tests, commits, non-force pushes, named GitHub Actions dispatch/poll/artifact download, bounded root-cause corrections, handoffs, same-phase transitions, and program-autopilot phase transitions through the automated P05-C01 code-candidate gate.

    For `ExecutionAuthorityV1`, those exact-fence branch/commit/non-force-push and named CI dispatch/read/poll/log/artifact/evidence operations are governed repository/CI evidence operations under `executorActor`/`evidenceProducer`; they are not the business-or-service side effects governed by `externalMutationOwner`. Therefore `externalMutationOwner = NONE` does not revoke the preceding bounded repository/CI authority. It still forbids force push/history rewrite, branch deletion, run cancellation used to bypass evidence, repository settings/secrets/environment-rule changes, or any action outside the named workflows unless a dossier explicitly grants narrower authority. `externalMutationOwner` controls App Store/TestFlight/signing/purchase, provider/backend/customer communications, public hosting/DNS/publication, ad spend, credentials, production rollout, field attestation, and comparable non-repository effects.

    This does not authorize parallel acceptance, broad staging, force push/history rewrite, repository settings/secrets, destructive real-customer data operations, signing/certificates/accounts, TestFlight/App Store submission/promotion, public hosting/DNS/publication, paid spend, external messages, or fabrication of owner/legal/licensing/professional/physical evidence. Stop only when one of those owner-only actions is unavoidable, an accepted dependency is genuinely missing, unowned work overlaps the exact card, or the safe-release scope requires a material product/privacy/claim/legal decision with no conservative fallback. Lack of green exact-head evidence prevents acceptance but is not an owner stop: official failure first records `ACCEPTANCE_FAILED` with its run/failure signature, may record the one non-accepting diagnostic sweep as `DIAGNOSTIC_COMPLETE_NON_ACCEPTING`, then transitions to `CORRECTION_REQUIRED`, triggers a bounded successor correction, and leaves unrelated eligible work free to continue.

    An absent optional decision sets its `OptionalDecisionGateV1` to DISABLED_OR_DEFERRED with reason/re-entry trigger and does not block unrelated work. V21-P00-C03 and every V21-P06 study reserve owner decision for `GO`/activation; CODEX may close conservative `NO_GO`/`DEFER` evidence when inputs are absent, withheld, stale, insufficient, or disconfirming.

    At V21-P05-C02, `ReleaseUXDispositionV1` is exactly `RELEASED | PHASED_RELEASE_ACTIVE | HOLD | REJECTED | WITHDRAWN | BLOCKED`. A runtime/physical waiver preserves `coverageStatus=NOT_RUN` and may document only a nonaccepting `HOLD` or `REJECTED` owner decision. It cannot accept/complete C02, authorize signing/submission/promotion, support an exact-coverage or accessibility claim, or make V21-P05-C03 eligible. Only `RELEASED` or `PHASED_RELEASE_ACTIVE` creates the monitor edge.

    ## 17. Explicitly deferred features

    V21 does not implement cloud sync, accounts/authentication/RBAC, a hosted public request/review portal, remote live collaboration, AI diagnosis or automatic safety/compliance decisions, full inventory/purchasing/payroll/billing/invoicing, generic EAV/form-builder architecture, GIS/BIM/AR/survey-grade geometry, a fifth root tab, implicit iPad support, or a new analytics/crash/attribution SDK. Installation and punch review ship only as the bounded local packages owned by C47/C33/C34; lighting commissioning and editable sign-message/artwork/fabrication remain deferred. No unsupported workflow is mislabeled as inspection, installation, punch review, preventive maintenance, repair, survey, or operational recheck.

    Shipping playground or irrigation packages, licensed standards text, playground/irrigation compliance claims, remote controller commands, telemetry/weather/device SDKs, route/polygon GIS, and backflow/certification decisions are deferred. Service-request intake, live timers, inventory, purchasing, labor rates/payroll, tax, invoices/payments, hosted portal delivery, provider APIs/SDKs, arbitrary adapter mapping, and in-app customer/product/acquisition telemetry remain excluded. V21's manual resource ledger, portable review files, and one flat-file adapter are complete within their dossiers and do not imply those larger systems. P06 validation/defer cards remain nonblocking and cannot grant hidden product scope.

    ## 18. Research synthesis and primary sources

    Research was rechecked on 2026-08-23. External pages prove documented behavior/requirements only; they do not prove adoption, quality, or competitor absence. Living requirements must be rechecked during implementation and before submission.

    ### Current HIG and Apple design language

    - [Human Interface Guidelines](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines) — the live official DocC hierarchy was recursively inventoried on 2026-08-22: 6 top-level categories, 8 intermediate Component subcategories, 157 leaf articles, and 171 nodes total. All resolved; Section 19 disposes every leaf exactly once.
    - [Design principles](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/design-principles) — visibly updated 2026-06-08; Apple's current principles are Purpose, Agency, Responsibility, Familiarity, Flexibility, Simplicity, Craft, and Delight. V21 interprets them through the existing five-value `PremiumExperiencePolicyV1`; it does not enlarge that closed enum.
    - [Designing for iOS](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/designing-for-ios), [Principles of great design](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/wwdc2026/250/), [Communicate your brand identity on iOS](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/wwdc2026/251/), [Design intuitive search experiences](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/wwdc2026/292/), and [Craft clear names](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/wwdc2026/290/) support familiar native structure, content-led brand expression, purposeful color/tint, restrained logos, scoped search, and precise names. They do not authorize replacing the accepted S10 identity or four roots.
    - [What's new in design](https://developer.apple.com/design/whats-new/) listed iOS 27 design resources, Icon Composer 2, and SF Symbols 8 as beta at this snapshot. Beta artwork, API, naming, and appearance remain diagnostic only.
    - [Accessibility Nutrition Labels overview](https://developer.apple.com/help/app-store-connect/manage-app-accessibility/overview-of-accessibility-nutrition-labels), [VoiceOver criteria](https://developer.apple.com/help/app-store-connect/manage-app-accessibility/voiceover-evaluation-criteria), [Voice Control criteria](https://developer.apple.com/help/app-store-connect/manage-app-accessibility/voice-control-evaluation-criteria), [Larger Text criteria](https://developer.apple.com/help/app-store-connect/manage-app-accessibility/larger-text-evaluation-criteria), [Sufficient Contrast criteria](https://developer.apple.com/help/app-store-connect/manage-app-accessibility/sufficient-contrast-evaluation-criteria), [Differentiate Without Color criteria](https://developer.apple.com/help/app-store-connect/manage-app-accessibility/differentiate-without-color-alone-evaluation-criteria), [Reduced Motion criteria](https://developer.apple.com/help/app-store-connect/manage-app-accessibility/reduced-motion-evaluation-criteria), and [Dark Interface criteria](https://developer.apple.com/help/app-store-connect/manage-app-accessibility/dark-interface-evaluation-criteria) establish capability-specific evaluation. V21 never converts an automated audit or one screen into an all-common-task App Store claim.
    - [Performing accessibility testing](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/accessibility/performing-accessibility-testing-for-your-app), [performing accessibility audits](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/accessibility/performing-accessibility-audits-for-your-app), and [testing system accessibility features](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/accessibility/testing-system-accessibility-features-in-your-app) support the candidate/physical boundary: deterministic audits find candidates; proficient physical use proves VoiceOver, Voice Control, Switch Control, and common-task behavior.

    ### Apple platform and release

    - [Upcoming submission requirements](https://developer.apple.com/news/upcoming-requirements/) — as of this snapshot, uploads require Xcode 26+ and the iOS 26 SDK since 2026-04-28; updated age-rating questions are active.
    - [Apple Releases](https://developer.apple.com/news/releases/) — the dated V21 snapshot separates stable iOS 26.6.1 (23G83) from stable Xcode 26.6 (17F113) and treats iOS/Xcode 27 beta evidence as non-accepting; implementation and pre-upload gates re-resolve the symbolic latest stable profiles.
    - [Transitioning to the UIKit scene-based life cycle](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/uikit/transitioning-to-the-uikit-scene-based-life-cycle) and [TN3208 launch-screen preparation](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/technotes/tn3208-preparing-your-apps-launch-screen-to-meet-app-store-requirements) drive C06's dated scene/launch dispositions and source→archive→clean-install checks rather than a speculative splash redesign.
    - [App Review Guidelines](https://developer.apple.com/app-store/review/guidelines/) — iPhone apps should run on iPad whenever possible; privacy policy must be present in metadata and easily accessible in app; capture requires explicit consent/indication and accurate metadata.
    - [Apple-silicon Mac availability](https://developer.apple.com/help/app-store-connect/manage-your-apps-availability/manage-availability-of-iphone-and-ipad-apps-on-macs-with-apple-silicon) and [Apple Vision Pro availability](https://developer.apple.com/help/app-store-connect/manage-your-apps-availability/manage-availability-of-iphone-and-ipad-apps-on-apple-vision-pro) — compatible iOS availability is an owner-controlled App Store Connect fact and may be on by default.
    - [Privacy manifests](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/bundleresources/privacy-manifest-files), [Required Reason APIs](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/bundleresources/describing-use-of-required-reason-api), [third-party SDK requirements](https://developer.apple.com/support/third-party-SDK-requirements/), [App Privacy details](https://developer.apple.com/app-store/app-privacy-details/), and [Manage App Privacy](https://developer.apple.com/help/app-store-connect/manage-app-information/manage-app-privacy).
    - [Adopting Swift 6](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/swift/adoptingswift6), [updating an app for strict concurrency](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/swift/updating-an-app-to-use-strict-concurrency), and [organizing tests for feedback](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/xcode/organizing-tests-to-improve-feedback).
    - [String Catalogs](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/xcode/localizing-and-varying-text-with-a-string-catalog), [state restoration](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/swiftui/restoring-your-app-s-state-with-swiftui), [background strategy](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/backgroundtasks/choosing-background-strategies-for-your-app), [file protection](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/uikit/encrypting-your-app-s-files), and [backup exclusion](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/foundation/urlresourcekey/isexcludedfrombackupkey).
    - [Accessibility Nutrition Labels](https://developer.apple.com/help/app-store-connect/manage-app-accessibility/overview-of-accessibility-nutrition-labels) — labels are device-specific and require all common tasks for a claimed feature.
    - [StoreKit testing](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/storekit/testing-at-all-stages-of-development-with-xcode-and-the-sandbox), [Transaction](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/storekit/transaction), and [`finish()`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/storekit/transaction/finish%28%29).
    - [`AppStore.sync()`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/storekit/appstore/sync%28%29) — call only for an explicit user action; normal StoreKit state stays current without an automatic launch sync.
    - [MetricKit](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/metrickit) and [Xcode 27 beta notes](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/xcode-release-notes/xcode-27-release-notes) — the new `MetricManager` path is beta/Xcode-27-era at this snapshot, so V21 preserves `MXMetricManager` behind a seam instead of compiling beta API under Xcode 26.
    - [App Intents discoverability](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/appintents/appintent/isdiscoverable) and [protected named Core Spotlight indexes](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/corespotlight/cssearchableindex/init%28name%3Aprotectionclass%3A%29) — intent discovery defaults on while private content indexing is a separate on-device choice; the default index is not the V21 production path.
    - [SwiftData managed-sync opt-out](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/swiftdata/modelconfiguration/cloudkitdatabase-swift.struct/none), [OSLog privacy](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/os/oslogprivacy), [OSSignposter](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/os/ossignposter), and [JSON Schema Draft 2020-12](https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12) support the explicit local-store, bounded diagnostics, and independent open-contract validation refinements. These are compatibility foundations, not cloud/telemetry features.
    - [App icons](https://developer.apple.com/help/app-store-connect/manage-app-information/add-an-app-icon), [screenshots](https://developer.apple.com/help/app-store-connect/manage-app-information/upload-app-previews-and-screenshots), [App Tags](https://developer.apple.com/help/app-store-connect/manage-app-information/manage-app-tags/), and [platform metadata](https://developer.apple.com/help/app-store-connect/reference/app-information/platform-version-information).
    - [App Store Connect acquisition analytics](https://developer.apple.com/help/app-store-connect-analytics/acquisition/acquisition/) and [campaign links](https://developer.apple.com/help/app-store-connect-analytics/acquisition/campaign-links) provide privacy-thresholded source/campaign impressions, product-page views, downloads, conversion, usage, sales, and subscriptions without requiring an analytics SDK in AssetRounds. Usage metrics include only eligible users who shared diagnostics/usage, and low-volume gaps are expected—not zeroes.
    - [Apple user privacy and data use](https://developer.apple.com/app-store/user-privacy-and-data-use/) and [App Privacy Details](https://developer.apple.com/app-store/app-privacy-details/) make any later analytics, email/newsletter, attribution, or audience activation a privacy and disclosure change. Apple classifies email—including hashed email—as Contact Info and direct marketing communications as Developer Advertising or Marketing; sharing email lists for retargeting/lookalikes is tracking. C43/C44 therefore freeze formulas/consent boundaries while collecting and transmitting nothing.

    ### Native premium experience and accessibility

    - Apple's current [design principles](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/design-principles), [launching](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/launching/), and [onboarding](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/onboarding) favor clear hierarchy, immediate entry, restoration, concise optional learning, consistency, feedback, forgiveness, and restraint. V21 therefore improves common-task continuity and point-of-need help instead of adding a forced tour.
    - [Get to know the new design system](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/wwdc2025/356/), [Adopting Liquid Glass](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/TechnologyOverviews/adopting-liquid-glass), and [Toolbars](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/toolbars) place current system material on the functional navigation/control layer and emphasize grouping, hierarchy, and native components. V21 lets standard controls adopt the stable SDK appearance but forbids decorative content-layer glass or a brand rewrite.
    - [WWDC26 platform updates](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/wwdc2026/102/), [WWDC26 SwiftUI updates](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/wwdc2026/269/), and the current [Search Fields HIG](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/search-fields) support C06's conditional compatibility-resizability evidence, native overflow/minimization, and one typed per-surface search-placement decision without claiming native iPad support.
    - [Writing](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/writing), [Feedback](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/feedback), [Alerts](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/alerts), [Loading](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/loading), and [Progress indicators](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/progress-indicators) support action verbs, inline status, proportional interruption, immediate content, accurate progress, cancel where safe, and useful recovery. AssetRounds additionally requires receipt/read-back before success copy.
    - [Motion](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/motion), [Reduced Motion criteria](https://developer.apple.com/help/app-store-connect/manage-app-accessibility/reduced-motion-evaluation-criteria/), and [Playing haptics](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/playing-haptics) support brief purposeful optional motion and sparse causal haptics that never communicate alone. V21 adds no custom motion or haptic engine.
    - [Improving app responsiveness](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/xcode/improving-app-responsiveness) identifies roughly 100 ms for discrete interaction and one display interval for continuous interaction; [improving performance](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/xcode/improving-your-app-s-performance) recommends measuring launch, hangs/hitches, memory, storage, energy, and thermal behavior on representative physical devices. V21's budgets and exact signposts make perceived quality executable without an analytics SDK.
    - [Accessibility](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/accessibility), [Larger Text criteria](https://developer.apple.com/help/app-store-connect/manage-app-accessibility/larger-text-evaluation-criteria), and [VoiceOver criteria](https://developer.apple.com/help/app-store-connect/manage-app-accessibility/voiceover-evaluation-criteria) support 44-point default controls, sufficient spacing, all Dynamic Type sizes including AX5, logical focus, status announcements, and media descriptions. App Store label claims still require all common tasks.

    ### Market workflow evidence

    - [MaintainX locations](https://help.getmaintainx.com/about-locations) and [asset hierarchies](https://help.getmaintainx.com/create-and-manage-asset-hierarchies), plus [UpKeep assets](https://help.onupkeep.com/en/articles/4658340-create-and-edit-assets) and [Limble asset organization](https://help.limblecmms.com/en/articles/2981817-organizing-your-assets).
    - [Mitti (formerly SafetyCulture/iAuditor) site hierarchy/import](https://help.safetyculture.com/000006), [asset/site CSV](https://help.safetyculture.com/004492), and the [2026 rename continuity notice](https://community.mitti.com/changelog/post/mitti-same-platform-new-name-L0nvsgmPN7Y8uQN).
    - [Fulcrum stable-ID update import](https://help.fulcrumapp.com/en/articles/93513-updating-existing-records-via-the-importer).
    - [SignAgent starter organization](https://support.signagent.com/knowledge/how-to-set-up-a-new-organization-from-the-starter-template) and [location-plan organization](https://support.signagent.com/knowledge/organizing-location-plans).

    The competitor scan supports hierarchy, stable-key imports, preview/error reporting, starter experiences, and explicit history. The focused V21 review further found:

    - Current [MaintainX App Store reviews](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/maintainx-work-orders/id1437854484?platform=iphone&see-all=reviews) praise quick setup, minimal training, and technician adoption. Current [Limble reviews](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/limble/id6755496529) praise a snappy, self-explanatory routine flow while reporting repeated worker selection and prompt friction. These anecdotes support task continuity and safe reviewed recent choices, not a generic personalization engine.
    - Current [UpKeep reviews](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/upkeep-work-order-maintenance/id921799415?platform=iphone&see-all=reviews), [Mitti reviews](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/mitti-by-safetyculture/id499999532?see-all=reviews), and [ArcGIS Field Maps reviews](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/arcgis-field-maps/id1515671684?see-all=reviews) report slowness, uncertain submit/save state, crashes, lost drafts, stalled media, and offline/photo failures. Individual reviews are not prevalence data; their convergence reinforces the inherited V20 durability and response-feedback/performance gates.
    - Current [GoCanvas reviews](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/gocanvas-business-forms/id418917158) describe disruptive workflow relocation after a visual refresh and repeated photo taps. [Fulcrum reviews/version history](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/fulcrum-gis-field-data-capture/id467758260) praise phone-based photo documentation and show continuing work on explicit draft/attachment states and lost-text/photo-memory faults. V21 freezes semantic common-task continuity and one independent per-item curation pipeline.
    - MaintainX's [mobile overview](https://help.getmaintainx.com/getting-started-new-users/mobile-app-overview), [procedure fields](https://help.getmaintainx.com/procedure-fields), and [work-order filters](https://help.getmaintainx.com/view-and-filter-work-orders), plus Fulcrum's [recent/default value settings](https://help.fulcrumapp.com/en/articles/462356-fulcrum-for-ios-app-settings), document task-first lists, conditional fields, direct scan entry, and bounded repetitive-entry aids. Vendor documentation proves feature shape, not quality; AssetRounds keeps high-risk field truth out of suggestions.
    - Mitti's [2026 rename continuity notice](https://community.mitti.com/changelog/post/mitti-same-platform-new-name-L0nvsgmPN7Y8uQN) explicitly preserved workflows, settings, data, and integrations through a visual identity change. It supports V21's rule that platform/brand polish must not force users to relearn common tasks.

    - [UpKeep offline workflow](https://help.onupkeep.com/en/articles/4712557-how-to-use-upkeep-offline), [Fulcrum synchronization](https://help.fulcrumapp.com/en/articles/8104466-how-does-syncing-on-the-mobile-app-work), [MaintainX offline mode](https://help.getmaintainx.com/offline-mode), and [Limble mobile offline behavior](https://help.limblecmms.com/en/articles/11698403-using-the-new-limble-mobile-app) make durable drafts, attachment progress, and truthful local/offline state a launch-level expectation. Vendor documentation proves claimed behavior and disclosed limits, not independent reliability.
    - [MaintainX reviews](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/maintainx-work-orders/id1437854484?platform=iphone&see-all=reviews), [Limble reviews](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/limble-cmms/id1108935725?platform=iphone&see-all=reviews), and current CMMS practitioner discussions repeatedly emphasize technician learning time, tap count, mobile stability, and report clarity; anecdotes are directional, not prevalence statistics.
    - [Mitti report layouts](https://help.safetyculture.com/en-US/000061/), [Fulcrum custom PDF reports](https://help.fulcrumapp.com/en/articles/4208268-customizing-pdf-reports), and [MaintainX Report Builder](https://help.getmaintainx.com/help-center-updates/august-2025) support bounded audience/layout profiles. V21 deliberately avoids arbitrary HTML/CSS/scripts or a second renderer.
    - [Asset Panda group scanning](https://help.assetpanda.com/Mobile_Group_Scan.html), [Mitti asset issue context](https://help.safetyculture.com/007082), and [MaintainX duplicate review](https://help.getmaintainx.com/global-asset-types) support retained search context, batch scan review, and explicit duplicate/related-work decisions rather than automatic merging.
    - [SignAgent mobile surveying](https://support.signagent.com/knowledge/surveying-in-signagent) records plan position and marker orientation, while Apple's [heading guidance](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/corelocation/getting-heading-and-course-information) and [accuracy contract](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/corelocation/clheading/headingaccuracy) require true/magnetic/uncertain states to remain distinct. V21 therefore implements reference-framed pose without importing GIS or continuous tracking.
    - [SignAgent Mobile](https://signagent.com/signagent-mobile/) and its [installation workflow](https://support.signagent.com/knowledge/installing-in-signagent) demonstrate sign-specific plan, installation, unable-to-install, evidence, and punch-list value. V21 adopts only local installation and punch-review semantics with more precise outcome language; it does not copy artwork, fabrication, cloud review, or production management.
    - [MaintainX QR export](https://help.getmaintainx.com/print-and-export-qr-codes) supports standard label sheets and vendor CSV handoff. V21-C30 uses opaque local locators, visible short codes, deterministic output, and the existing renderer; it does not add a hosted resolver or supplier marketplace.
    - [Jobber client actions](https://help.getjobber.com/en/articles/client-information-in-the-jobber-app/) demonstrates the field value of direct call/text access. V21-C31 adds only user-initiated system directions/call/text/email handoffs and never claims the other app sent, delivered, or logged the communication.
    - [MaintainX work-order completion](https://help.getmaintainx.com/complete-a-work-order) demonstrates demand for time, labor, cost, and parts context. V21-C49/C36 deliberately stops at manual duration, material description/quantity, and optional direct cost—no live timer, inventory, rates, payroll, purchasing, tax, or invoice.
    - [MaintainX request portals](https://help.getmaintainx.com/set-up-a-request-portal) demonstrate external request/review demand but also imply hosted identity and service scope. V21-C48/C35 instead uses bounded customer-safe files, possession-bound tamper evidence, self-asserted recipient identity, explicit import preview, and no portal/backend/delivery claim.
    - Apple's [ratings and reviews guidance](https://developer.apple.com/app-store/ratings-and-reviews/) supports a system request after meaningful engagement at a natural stopping point. V21-C39 uses only locally derived eligibility after receipt-confirmed value, never a custom “Are you happy?” gate, reward, telemetry event, or support diversion.
    - [MaintainX procedure fields](https://help.getmaintainx.com/procedure-fields) demonstrates current conditional-field/response flexibility; V21 deliberately chooses a smaller exact grammar with tri-state predicates, bounded repeats, deterministic invalidation, and no scripts or generic form builder.
    - [MaintainX asset hierarchies](https://help.getmaintainx.com/create-and-manage-asset-hierarchies), [Park Protector](https://playgroundguardian.com/solutions/playground-inspection-software/), [Tapigo](https://www.tapigo.com/), and [Rain Bird IQ4](https://www.rainbird.com/usa/iq4-main) show structural and functional relationships, offline evidence, schedules, controllers/zones/sensors, maps, priorities, and remote commands as recurring shapes. They justify the bounded shared seam, not a claim of superiority or permission to ship remote operation.
    - The [CPSC 2025 Playground Safety Handbook](https://www.cpsc.gov/Playground-Handbook), [ASTM F1487-25](https://store.astm.org/f1487-25.html), [DOJ 2010 ADA Standards](https://www.ada.gov/law-and-regs/design-standards/2010-stds/), and [EPA WaterSense professional certification](https://www.epa.gov/watersense/professional-certification) show why edition, adoption, applicability, inspector qualification, and rights provenance cannot be one “current standard” switch. Guidance/standards are not universal law and copyrighted source text is not bundled without rights.
    - [ISO 55001:2024](https://www.iso.org/standard/83054.html), [ISO 55013:2024](https://www.iso.org/standard/82455.html), [UCUM](https://ucum.org/ucum), and [W3C PROV-O](https://www.w3.org/TR/prov-o/) support lifecycle/data quality, unambiguous units, and agent/activity/entity provenance. V21 adopts only bounded relevant semantics and does not become enterprise asset management or a general provenance engine.

    V21 adopts these durable patterns through AssetRounds' existing offline writer/receipt/lifecycle/brand model rather than copying hosted accounts, portals, enterprise dispatch, or unrestricted customization. App Store reviews are individual, territory-specific, dynamically ordered evidence; vendor pages and changelogs are self-reported. Recheck dates, plan gates, and platform requirements at implementation and release.

    ### GitHub Actions and test efficiency

    - [GitHub workflow syntax](https://docs.github.com/en/actions/reference/workflows-and-actions/workflow-syntax), [Actions limits](https://docs.github.com/en/actions/reference/limits), and the [concurrency-groups REST API](https://docs.github.com/en/rest/actions/concurrency-groups?apiVersion=2026-03-10) — job-level `queue: max` retains up to 100 pending members but cannot combine with `cancel-in-progress: true`; V21 uses five fixed hosted-job slot groups, a much smaller inventory-derived typed pending bound, no order-dependent correctness, no placeholder work, and an explicit five-total running-capacity manifest. Only the in-progress member owns a lease; `queue: single` remains limited to replaceable nonauthoritative workflow wakes.
    - [GitHub Deployments](https://docs.github.com/en/rest/deployments/deployments?apiVersion=2026-03-10), [deployment statuses](https://docs.github.com/en/rest/deployments/statuses?apiVersion=2026-03-10), and [deployment environments](https://docs.github.com/en/actions/how-tos/deploy/configure-and-manage-deployments/control-deployments) — the explicit owner authorization is a Deployment object in a distinct non-protected ledger environment; every ledger status sets `auto_inactive: false`, the actual protected environment exists in the payload and its separate environment-job Deployment is only linked, serialized short state/digests use append-only statuses, prior-status evidence rolls over before GitHub's 90-day history window, and each new environment-bearing attempt receives current protection/secrets rather than inheriting an earlier run.
    - [The `workflow_run` event](https://docs.github.com/en/actions/reference/workflows-and-actions/events-that-trigger-workflows#workflow_run), [triggering a workflow](https://docs.github.com/en/actions/how-tos/write-workflows/choose-when-workflows-run/trigger-a-workflow), [workflow dispatch REST](https://docs.github.com/en/rest/actions/workflows?apiVersion=2026-03-10), and [workflow-run status enum](https://docs.github.com/en/rest/actions/workflow-runs?apiVersion=2026-03-10) — a minimal completion bridge dispatches a fresh returned-run-ID-bound canonical run instead of chaining batch execution past GitHub's workflow-run depth limit, and the legacy cutover drains every documented nonterminal status.
    - [Xcode 13.3 release notes](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/xcode-release-notes/xcode-13_3-release-notes) — portable `.xctestproducts` enables build-for-testing once and test-without-building across compatible execution destinations when artifact identity matches.
    - [upload-artifact permission loss](https://github.com/actions/upload-artifact#permission-loss), [secure workflow use](https://docs.github.com/en/actions/reference/security/secure-use), and [Actions limits](https://docs.github.com/en/actions/reference/limits) — archive executable products before transport, pin actions, use least privilege, and govern the five hosted-job slots across every workflow.

    ## 19. Complete current Apple HIG applicability matrix

    ### 19.1 Authority, taxonomy, and row grammar

    Research snapshot: **2026-08-22**. Apple’s live first-party HIG DocC hierarchy resolved to **6 top-level categories, 8 intermediate Component subcategories, 157 leaf articles, and 171 taxonomy nodes total**; every published node resolved. The [Human Interface Guidelines index](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines) is the authoritative entry point. Page links below are official Apple sources. “Observed update” is Apple’s visible DocC change-log date when exposed; <code>not shown</code> does not mean unchanged or unpublished. Re-crawl the taxonomy and re-resolve stable runtimes at implementation and before upload. Page update dates and platform tags are not API availability declarations.

    Dispositions are closed: <code>APPLICABLE</code> means the inherited or added V21 feature/behavior must implement and prove the row; <code>PLATFORM_HANDLED</code> means iOS owns presentation but AssetRounds must integrate and semantically test it; <code>NOT_APPLICABLE_WITH_RATIONALE</code> means the exact row rationale is the absence proof; <code>DEFERRED_OUTSIDE_V21</code> preserves an explicit boundary and cannot activate work. A component discovered at accepted S10.6 or while implementing any V21 surface invalidates an <code>R-ABSENT</code> row and must be reclassified before C27 accepts. The matrix is planning evidence over existing contracts, not a runtime database, schema, certification, or new card.

    Codes keep 157 rows reviewable while preserving every required field:

    - Surfaces: <code>ALL</code>, <code>ROOTS</code>, <code>FORM</code>, <code>MEDIA</code>, <code>FILE</code>, <code>REPORT</code>, <code>SET</code>, <code>DASH</code>, <code>REL</code>, <code>WORK</code>, <code>INTENTS</code>; J01–J14 are the frozen common journeys. <code>NONE</code> means no shipping surface.
    - Repo evidence/gap: <code>R-USED</code> = the live app, inherited V20 scope, or added V21 scope uses the behavior, but accepted S10.6 and all implemented V21 surfaces must be re-inventoried; <code>R-SYSTEM</code> = an existing/planned system adapter or native component owns presentation; <code>R-ABSENT</code> = no live or V21 surface; <code>R-DEFERRED</code> = explicit V21 exclusion/re-entry boundary.
    - Refinement: <code>F-G</code> global native policy; <code>F-AX</code> accessibility; <code>F-COPY</code> wording/localization; <code>F-NAV</code> navigation/restoration; <code>F-SHELL</code> shell/settings/layout; <code>F-FORM</code> entry/focus; <code>F-MEDIA</code> evidence/media; <code>F-LOAD</code> loading; <code>F-FEEDBACK</code> response truth; <code>F-MATERIAL</code> system-material boundary; <code>F-MOTION</code> motion/haptics; <code>F-NATIVE</code> native presentation with no custom copy; other <code>F-*</code> labels name the equally bounded existing concern. <code>N</code> is the row’s no-surface/platform rationale; <code>D</code> is exclusion only.
    - Brand: <code>B0</code> no app-authored visual change; <code>B-DELTA</code> changed surface and affected journeys only; <code>B-SHARED</code> shared-owner change plus computed consumers; <code>B-GATE</code> ordinary delta unless one closed global brand-authority trigger actually changes, then stop for owner authorization. A system appearance change alone is always <code>B0</code>.
    - Runtime: <code>M18</code> = exact iOS 18 semantic/API fallback and no backported modern material; <code>LATEST-STABLE</code> = re-resolved stable shipping OS with native presentation. OS versions may differ in pixels but not task, truth, role, focus, recovery, or accessibility.
    - Accessibility: <code>AX-G</code> general semantics; <code>AX-C</code> contrast/noncolor; <code>AX-I</code> icon/image meaning; <code>AX-L</code> layout/target/reflow; <code>AX-T</code> text/Dynamic Type; <code>AX-RTL</code> bidirectional layout/content; <code>AX-MO</code> motion alternatives; <code>AX-F</code> forms/keyboard/errors; <code>AX-N</code> navigation/focus; <code>AX-M</code> media alternatives; <code>AX-CH</code> chart equivalents; <code>AX-VO</code> proficient VoiceOver; <code>AX-0</code> no shipping surface.
    - Evidence: <code>E-SEM</code> static inventory plus semantic/route/state/accessibility tests and affected app-owned snapshots; <code>E-SYSTEM</code> whole-screen human context plus role/state/target/safe-area/focus/outcome proof with native chrome excluded from cross-OS pixel gates; <code>E-PHYS</code> exact-build physical P05-C02 evidence; <code>E-ABSENCE</code> code/surface inventory plus written rationale; <code>E-DEFER</code> Release-exclusion and no-activation proof. <code>FAIL</code>, <code>NOT_RUN</code>, diagnostic output, or an unexplained missing row never accepts.

    ### 19.2 Runtime, ownership, and acceptance closure

    - **Exact minimum:** deployment target remains iOS 18.0. Test the exact-minimum semantic/API path separately from the currently maintained iOS 18 patch. No iOS-26-only API appears without <code>#available</code> and an iOS-18 fallback that preserves the same task and state truth.
    - **Pinned stable toolchain:** Xcode 26.6 with its iOS 26.5 SDK/Simulator is a reproducible CI lane, not proof of the newest shipping patch.
    - **Latest shipping stable:** the snapshot is iOS 26.6.1 (<code>23G83</code>, 2026-08-17). P00-C06 re-resolves this symbolically and P05-C02 provides a current physical/device-farm row when required.
    - **Beta diagnostic:** iOS 27 beta 6 (<code>24A5418b</code>) and Xcode 27 beta 5 were beta on the snapshot date. Their separately labeled diagnostic may reveal future risk, but cannot block release, update S10/V21 goldens, introduce beta APIs/artwork, or accept a card.
    - **System variation:** native bars, controls, lists/forms, keyboards, dialogs, share/file pickers, Dynamic Type metrics, semantic colors, SF Symbols, materials, animations, and haptics may differ by runtime/device/settings. Gate semantic parity and nonocclusion, not identical pixels.
    - **Physical truth:** automation may propose accessibility candidates only. P05-C02 alone physically proves proficient VoiceOver/Voice Control, Switch Control, Full Keyboard Access, oldest supported iPhone performance, real camera/media behavior, bright-exterior use, and left/right one-handed reach. Do not publish a capability label or universal sunlight/glove/ruggedness claim from screenshots or simulation.
    - **Objective app policy:** app-authored hit regions are at least 44 by 44 points; normal text is at least 4.5:1 and meaningful nontext/state boundaries at least 3:1; text is separately proven at 200 percent and AX5. These are adopted AssetRounds release thresholds based on Apple accessibility guidance, not a claim that every HIG sentence is a mandatory App Store rule.
    - **Original plus expansion:** C27 inventories the accepted S10.6/original application states and every state introduced by inherited V20 plus added V21 scope in one current application graph. C28 fixes one lowest truthful owner. C29 freezes one release-candidate closure. No parallel legacy UI, V21 theme, or second component system is permitted.
